It was embarrassing to them, but how much intolerance can we put up with along the way to make progress? Can we or should we expect a long-entrenched religion to shift all of its values at once or would this just polarize and entrench positions? What about the women who are treated as second-class people for some sectors of the religion? What is fair to them? Those are rhetorical questions, but feel free to answer any of them.
